text: The present document defines O-RAN OAM interface functions and protocols for the O-RAN O1 interface for the Near RT RIC. The document studies the functions conveyed over the interface, including management functions, procedures, operations, and corresponding solutions, and identifies existing standards and industry work that can serve as a basis for O-RAN work.
text_preview: This document defines O-RAN OAM interface functions and protocols for the Near RT RIC's O1 interface. It studies management functions, procedures, operations, and solutions, identifying existing standards and industry work to inform O-RAN development.
